title: The Colon Trap
summary: A greeting spell fails because the function declaration is incomplete.
themeStory: The Syntax Spider tangled the greeting spell. Restore the function so the town gates open.
objective: Fix the syntax so the function runs and prints the greeting.
conceptExplanation: Python function declarations must end with a colon, and indentation defines the function body.
successMessage: The web of syntax snaps and the gate swings open.
recap: You repaired a Python syntax error by adding the missing colon after the function definition.

title: The Zero Warden
summary: The average calculator crashes when there are no scores.
themeStory: The Runtime Sentinel punishes reckless division. Add a safe path when no scores exist.
objective: Prevent a crash when count is zero.
conceptExplanation: Runtime errors happen while the program is running. Dividing by zero raises an exception in Python.
successMessage: The sentinel lowers its shield as the calculation stabilizes.
recap: You handled a runtime error by checking input before division.

title: The Loop Labyrinth
summary: The loop forgets to count the final number in the range.
themeStory: The Logic Gatekeeper loves off-by-one mistakes. Count every step to leave the maze.
objective: Make the function return the total from 1 through 5.
conceptExplanation: Logic bugs produce the wrong result even though the code runs. Python ranges exclude the stop value.
successMessage: The maze walls shift aside when the final step is counted.
recap: You fixed a logic bug by correcting the loop boundary.

title: The Semicolon Shrine
summary: A message ritual fails because one statement never ends.
themeStory: The Semicolon Spirit blocks the shrine until every Java statement is properly sealed.
objective: Fix the syntax so the Java program is valid.
conceptExplanation: Java statements usually end with semicolons. Missing one causes a syntax error during compilation.
successMessage: The shrine glows as the final semicolon clicks into place.
recap: You repaired a Java syntax error by ending the assignment statement properly.

title: The Null Phantom
summary: The phantom appears when the code tries to read a missing name.
themeStory: The Null Phantom haunts careless code. Protect the method before touching a missing value.
objective: Prevent a null-related crash when the name is missing.
conceptExplanation: A NullPointerException happens when code uses an object reference that is null.
successMessage: The phantom fades as the method checks for null before reading the name.
recap: You handled a Java runtime bug by guarding against null values.

title: The Boss Gate
summary: The final gate opens only if the average is calculated correctly for all students.
themeStory: The Boss Bug twists the average formula. Repair the logic and claim the final badge.
objective: Return the correct average value from total and count.
conceptExplanation: Logic bugs can hide in valid code. Here, the formula is reversed.
successMessage: The final gate unlocks as the formula aligns with reality.
recap: You fixed a logic bug by correcting the average formula.
